Name: Skeleton Critter Swarm
Information:
**Skeleton Critter**

A small skeletal beast made from the bones of a small creature like a goblin, dog, kobold, or otherwise. They are used as fodder and as alarm systems.

**Pact of the Chain.** A warlock who takes the Pact of the Chain may choose a skeleton critter as their familiar. When they do, it considers the warlock to be an undead for the purposes of its effects.

Stat Blocks.title: Skeleton Critter Swarm
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can’t speak

traits.name: Engulfing Swarm
traits.description: The spaces the swarm occupies are difficult terrain for all non-undead creatures, and each non-undead creature who moves into a square occupied by the swarm takes 4 (1d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Undead Tactics
traits.description: The swarm has advantage on attack rolls against targets when another undead ally is within 5 feet of their target, unless those undead are incapacitated. The members of the swarm do not count as allies for this purpose.

actions.name: Rotting Rampage
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, targets all creatures in the swarm’s space. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage if the swarm has less than half their hit points.

actions.name: Thunderous Blare (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The swarm members unleash their blaring screams at once, forcing each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the swarm to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (5d10) thunder damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If the swarm has less than half its total hit points, this deals 16 (3d10) thunder damage (or half) instead.
